swimming_pool.evidence: A round turquoise above-ground pool sits directly beside the central house on its right side, with a deck area next to it.

detached_structure.evidence: A small brown-roofed structure at the left edge of the central lot's yard, partly shaded by trees, could be a shed. A small gray-roofed structure adjoins the neighboring house to the upper right, but it belongs to that lot.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray-shingled roof, a paved driveway to the left, and a round above-ground pool on its right, with heavy tree canopy on the surrounding lot.
